description: Image Description: The image shows a close-up view of several pairs of skis and ski poles resting on a snowy surface. The skis are positioned at various angles, with some parallel and others crossing each other. The ski poles are standing upright, casting shadows on the snow. The scene is brightly lit, indicating daylight, and the snow appears compacted, likely from foot traffic or skiers. The skis have visible bindings and are primarily white with red and black accents.
